info.title: Pipelinq POS split-tender register fragment
info.description: ADR-037 modular fragment adding the posTenderType and posTender schemas (multi-tender POS payment: cash + card + voucher), their register membership, and seed data. Deep-merged onto pipelinq_register.json by ConfigFileLoaderService; the components.objects[] seeds and the pipelinq register schemas[] membership are additively unioned (never replaced).

changeDue.description: Cash change due to the customer on settlement, server-computed from the tenders when a change-allowing cash tender overpays the total (pos-split-tender). Zero/absent when the payment was exact.
changeDue.title: Change due

posTenderType.title: POS Tender Type
posTenderType.summary: A configurable payment method (tender type) available at the POS checkout
posTenderType.description: Defines an available tender method (Contant/Cash, Betaalpas/Card, Cadeaubon/Voucher, Rekening/Account, or an integrated provider). Each type carries the GL posting account in shillinq that its tenders settle to, plus capability flags (requiresReference, requiresPin, allowsChange). Configured per register by an administrator. Mapped to Schema.org PaymentMethod.

name.description: Display name shown at checkout, e.g. Contant, Betaalpas, Cadeaubon
name.title: Name

code.description: Stable constant identifier for this tender method
code.title: Code

description.description: Optional description of this tender type
description.title: Description

glAccount.description: GL account number in shillinq this tender posts to (e.g. 1100 kas, 1200 bank, 2100 cadeaubonnen)
glAccount.title: GL account

requiresReference.description: Whether a tender of this type requires an external reference (card auth code, voucher serial)
requiresReference.title: Requires reference

requiresPin.description: Whether PIN verification is required (typically CARD only)
requiresPin.title: Requires PIN

allowsChange.description: Whether change is calculated for overpayment with this tender (typically CASH only)
allowsChange.title: Allows change

isActive.description: Whether this tender type is offered for new sales
isActive.title: Active

sortOrder.description: Display order in the tender selection UI (ascending)
sortOrder.title: Sort order

posTender.title: POS Tender
posTender.summary: A single payment (tender) applied to a POS transaction
posTender.description: Represents one payment method instance on a posTransaction (e.g. EUR 60 cash, EUR 66.06 card). The sum of all posTender.amount on a transaction MUST reconcile to posTransaction.total before the transaction may settle; this is enforced server-side by PosPaymentService::validateTenderSum (cash overpayment is allowed as change when the tender type allowsChange). glAccount is copied server-side from the tenderType at add time; client-supplied glAccount is never trusted. Mapped to Schema.org PaymentChargeSpecification.

transaction.description: UUID reference to the parent posTransaction
transaction.title: Transaction

tenderType.description: UUID reference to the posTenderType used for this payment
tenderType.title: Tender type

amount.description: Amount paid with this tender in EUR (server-validated >= 0.01)
amount.title: Amount

reference.description: External reference (card auth code, voucher serial) when the tender type requires one
reference.title: Reference

glAccount.description: GL account this tender posts to, copied server-side from the tender type at add time
glAccount.title: GL account

notes.description: Optional notes (e.g. partial voucher, retry after decline)
notes.title: Notes

sortOrder.description: Display order in the tender list (ascending)
sortOrder.title: Sort order

glPosted.description: Whether this tender's GL CloudEvent has been emitted (set true on settlement; the retry job re-emits when false)
glPosted.title: GL posted

glPostAttempts.description: Number of GL CloudEvent emission attempts; the retry job soft-fails after the configured cap
glPostAttempts.title: GL post attempts
